AGENDA
  Old Town La Verne Business Improvement District
  Advisory Board

  Monday, November 3, 2025 – 8:30 am
  2316 D Street – Café Wang

1. WELCOME AND CALL TO ORDER-

  Board Members  City Representatives/Others Present
  Craig Walters, Chair  Ken Domer, City Manager

  Council Meeting (Sidewalk Policy)  Monday, November 17th 6:30pm

   OLD TOWN LA VERNE BUSINESS IMPROVEMENT DISTIRICT
  MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETING
  Monday, August 4, 2025

1. WELCOME AND CALL TO ORDER

  The meeting began at 8:32 a.m.

  Advisory Board Members present: Craig Walters, Micky Rehm, George Henderson, and
  Marianne Stark. Advisory Board Members not present: Zuhey Espinoza.
  City Representatives present: Community Development Director Eric Scherer, City
  Manager Ken Domer, Councilmember Steve Johnson, and Secretary Natalie Hiatt. Others
  present: Fang Wang, Ken Valmonte, Cindy Vallejo-Victoria, Francisco Ramirez, Roy
  Cannizzo, Roberta Virgin and Wendy Norton.

2. CALENDAR
  Beer Walk  Cancelled
  Halloween Trick or Treat  Friday, October 31st 3pm-6pm
  Holiday Stroll  Saturday, December 13th 3pm

3. APPROVAL OF THE MINUTES June 2, 2025

  It was moved by Ms. Stark and seconded by Mr. Henderson to approve the minutes of
  June 2, 2025. Minutes approved by a 4-0 vote.

4. NEW BUSINESS

  A. University Dinner Crawl – Ms. Vallejo-Victoria Director of the University’s Student
  Engagement and Leadership Department announced that the Dinner Crawl will be
  held Thursday, August 28th from 4pm-6pm. Ms. Vallejo-Victoria is seeking 6-7
  restaurants to participate. She estimates 200-300 students will participate. More
  information will be emailed to the group.

  The BID group agreed to provide a band at Mainiero Square for the Dinner Crawl
  event.

  Ms. Vallejo-Victoria announced that August 15th is the official move-in day.

5. CONTINUED BUSINESS
   A. Sidewalk Dining Policy Update – Mr. Scherer stated that the City is in the process of
  making changes to the policy and January 1, 2026 is the new implementation date.
  Major changes include a flat rate charge instead of a per square foot charge.

  B. Walk of Honor Update – Chairperson Walters announced that the group is moving
  forward with the Walk of Honor Program and recognizing 10 individuals. The paver
  design will pay homage to the Pride of La Verne citrus label. Each paver will be 15
  inches square, black marble, and will recognize an individual, couple, or organization
  for their community involvement. The pavers are expected to be installed by the
  Holiday Stroll event.

  C. Street Light Banners Update – Ms. Rehm stated that she is working with Courier
  Printing and in the process of deciding on a banner design. The group is also
  considering selling banners to Old Town businesses for advertising.

  Mr. Scherer stated that the brackets arrived about two weeks ago. The Public Works
  Department will be responsible for the installation.

6. COMMITTEE REPORTS/ UPDATES

  A. City Report (Eric Scherer): Mr. Domer thanked everyone and stated that he is
  looking forward to the relationship with the Association.

  B. University Report (Zuhey Espinoza): Ms. Vallejo-Victoria announced that
  Homecoming will be held October 3-4.

  C. Chamber Report: Ms. Stark announced that the new CEO/Director of the Chamber
  started on Friday, August 1st. The Chamber will also be seeking a part-time employee
  to assist in the office.

  D. Financial Report: None

7. PUBLIC COMMENT (Any discussion or action on non-agendized items must be
  deferred to the following meeting, as required by California Brown Act Law)

  Mr. Cannizzo stated that many of the American flags that were displayed for the Fourth
  of July are faded. Mr. Scherer will speak to the Public Works Director regarding the
  issue.

  Ms. Rehm asked for information regarding the Police Department’s contract.

  Mr. Domer explained that even though the contract expired on June 30th it will continue
  during contract negotiations.

  Ms. Rehm stated that Wendy Norton has offered to help with the group’s social media
  account.
 8. ADJOURNMENT

  The meeting was adjourned at 9:10am, the next regular meeting to be held on November
  3, 2025 at 8:30 a.m. at Café Wang – 2316 D Street, La Verne CA 91750.

  Respectively submitted,

  _____________________
  Natalie Hiatt
minutes_text:
OLD TOWN LA VERNE BUSINESS TMPROVEMENT DISTIRICT
  MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETING
  Monday, November 3, 2025

1. WELCOME AND CALL TO ORDER
  The meeting began at 8:32 a.m.

  Mr. Scherer introduced Chamber of Commerce Director Matthew Duran and Assistant
  City Planner Valerie Chin.

  Advisory Board Members present: Craig Walters, Micky Rehm and George Henderson.
  Advisory Board Members not present: Zuhey Espinoza and Marianne Stark.
  City Representatives present: Community Development Director Eric Scherer, Public
  Works Director Danny Wu, Assistant Planner Valerie Chin and Secretary Natalie Hiatt.
  Others present: Fang Wang, Ken Valmonte, Francisco Ramirez, Anna Valiente Gomez,
  Matthew Duran and Wendy Norton.

2. CALENDAR
  Halloween Trick or Treat  Friday, October 31't 3pm-6pm
  Council Meeting  Monday, November 17th 6:30pm
  Cruisin La Verne Car Show  Saturday, November 22od 9am-3pm
  Holiday Stroll  Saturday, December 13th 3pm
  Cool Cruise Car Show  Saturday, April 4th 9am-3pm
  Wine Walk  Saturday, April 18th 5pm-8:30pm

3. APPROVAL OF THE MINUTES August 4,2025
  It was moved by Mr. Henderson and seconded by Ms. Rehm to approve the minutes of
  August 4,2025. Minutes approved by a 3-0 vote.

4. NEW BUSINESS
  A. Cruisin La Verne Car Show - Chairperson Walters stated that the Association no
  longer has a contract for the car show. Mr. Domer worked with the Chamber of
  Commerce to host the car show. There will be booth opportunities available for the
  event.
  B. Holiday Stroll- Ms. Rehm sent the postcard pricing to the new event coordinator.
  Chairperson Walters stated that the event is expanding with a street closure on 3'd
  Street, vendor booths, activities, and the Historical Society will be present. Mr.
  Scherer will check with the Fire Department to see if the antique fire engine is
  available. Santa Claus willtake pictures in Mainiero Square between 3pm-5:30pm
   and the reading and tree tighting will follow at 6pm. Mr. Henderson and Chairperson
  Walters stated that more holiday decorations will be added to Mainiero Square. The
  group requested volunteers to help decorate on Saturday, November 29th.

  C. Event Coordinator - Chairperson Walters announced that the Association hired Sheila
  Rodriguez to assist with events. Ms. Rodrguez also works for the University of La
  Verne as an Event Coordinator. Ms. Rodriguez was unable to attend today's meeting.

5. CONTINUED BUSINESS
  A. Sidewalk Dining Policy Update - Mr. Scherer stated that the policy will be presented
  to the City Council at the November lTth meeting. The updated policy includes
  modified fees.
  B. Walk of Honor Update - Chairperson Walters stated that they are trying to install the
  pavers in time for Holiday Stroll. There are some concems with the material chosen
  for the pavers. The City's insurance company is reviewing the product before it's
  installed.
  C. Street Light Banners Update - Ms. Rehm stated that the banners were ordered and
  will be ready next week.

6. COMMITTEE REPORTS/ UPDATES
  A. City Report (Eric Scherer): This evening's Council meeting will include the Public
  Hearing for the water rate increase.
  B. University Report (Zuhey Espinoza): None
  C. Chamber Report: Mr. Duran announced the 25th annual Taste of La Verne was
  rescheduled to March 4,2026at the Metropolitan in Pomona. Mr. Scherer announced
  that the Shop La Verne banner program is returning. Mr. Duran stated that the
  banners can be purchased for $350/year. The banners are expected to be installed in
  spring 2026.
  D. Financial Report: None

7. PUBLIC COMMENT (Any discussion or action on non-agendized items must be
  deferred to the following meeting, as required by California Brown Act Law)

  Mr. Henderson asked if a solution was made with Waste Management regarding the trash
  for the properties between D and E Streets.

  Mr. Wu stated that the issue needs to be resolved between Waste Management and the
  business.

  Chairperson Walters asked when the holiday d6cor will be put out.

  Ms. Rehm expressed concem with the Gold Line in regard to the train schedule, traffic,
  timing, and speeding down the alleyway of 3'd Street.
   Mr. Scherer stated that the Gold Line is still undergoing monitoring and testing. The City
  Engineer is aware and is working with Metro on improvements. Mr. Scherer will notify
  the Police Department of the speeding in the alleyway.

  Chairperson Walters added concerns with Public Safety's ability to respond with the train
  crossing at E Street and stated that signage needs improving.

  Ms. Rehm asked why this year's coloring contest entries were not posted in the
  businesses. Mr. Scherer will follow-up with Parks and Recreation Director Yvonne
  Duran.

8. ADJOURNMENT
  The meeting was adjourned at9:l6am, the next regular meeting to be held on February
  3,2026 at 8:30 a.m. at Caf6 Wang -2316 D Street, La Veme CA 91750.

  Natalie Hiatt
